definition: a meal eaten in the middle of the day
description: A woman in a blue shirt lowers a large empty white plate onto a wooden dining table by a sunny window. A serving spoon lifts rigatoni and spaghetti in tomato sauce out of a pan and sets a portion on the plate, finished with a basil leaf. The camera pulls back over a long table laid with cutlery and many identical plates of pasta, a family already seated around it in the midday light, and the woman spreads her arms to invite everyone to eat.

taps.phrase: to put down a big plate
to put pasta on the plate
